title: The Drop of Kowloon
author: Kestrel Vasquez
blurb: Wendell Vasquez, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
